strings.name: Bernie Sanders
strings.summary: Born in New York, Sanders moved to Vermont after graduating from Chicago, advancing from Burlington mayor to Congress and the Senate in 2007. An independent who caucuses with Democrats, he advocates universal health care, labour rights and reduced inequality. His unsuccessful bids for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2016 and 2020 broadened progressive policy debate. He won Senate reelection in 2024.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He has long advanced universal health care, income distribution and labour issues; his presidential campaigns changed American progressive policy debate.
